about: Public projects (src/core2/modules/projects.ts): a public work is the year's award of a capital line to a town firm. Each number is tagged SOURCED (with citation), ESTIMATED (with source and spread) or TUNABLE (with the spread it's checked against).
linesReason: The budget lines whose purchases are capital works (src/core2/data/budgets/treasury-spending.json purchasedShare: Census 2022 Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances capital outlay over the function's spending); a ribbon marks a finished road, park, housing or school work.

ribbonWindowDays.source: How long after a public work finishes an official can still cut its ribbon: dedications and grand openings follow completion within weeks, and are rarely held more than a couple of months later; no count exists.

projectMinimumPaidMinor.source: A work counts as built only if the treasury paid the contractor something for it that year (one cent); a line the treasury never paid has no work to open.
